parsed.summary: The PR adds get/set_antialiased methods to Text objects and adjusts the backend to use these methods. The changes are minimal and well-structured.

issues.description: The new methods and parameters introduced in Text objects do not follow the naming convention used in other similar methods (e.g., set/get_linewidth).
